newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Banco Consolidado first half net up 87 pct.
newsitem.headline: Banco Consolidado first half net up 87 pct.

text.p: Venezuelan state-owned bank Banco Consolidado, due to be privatised in November, reported a rise in first half net profits of 87 percent to 16 billion bolivars ($34 million) compared to the second half of 1995 results.
Total deposits rose 34 percent to 295 billion bolivars, while net worth grew 73 percent to reach 37.22 billion bolivars, the bank said in a press release.
A Bank spokesman said the figures were expressed in inflation-adjusted June 1996 bolivars, but could not provide comparative figures.
